findings.summary: Committed wrangler-vitest.toml is invalid TOML; clean checkout test command runs 0 tests and CI quality-gates would fail.
Invite-code creation lacks assertCanAssignRole; a holder of reg-key:add can mint a master-role invite and register as site owner.
Admin delete paths bypass lifecycle transaction; batch delete re-evaluates dynamic conditions and can delete newly arrived mail without attachment cleanup.
System storage config changes have no existing-object guard, unlike user BYO changes; old objects and deletion queue may lose their backend.
UNKNOWN outbound tasks have no reconciliation to ACCEPTED/FAILED; quota remains reserved and duplicate sends may occur.
Personal forwarding fallback drops attachments/CID and has no durable per-target task; inbound is marked COMPLETE before forwarding.
Internal delivery bypasses user rules, labels, notifications and personal forwarding.
Encrypted subject/body are filtered by SQL LIKE before decryption; total and pagination do not represent visible matches.
First passkey activation does not issue recovery codes; after consuming the last backup code there is no factor-rotation channel.
OAuth first-password eligibility depends on a KV marker; a lost write permanently blocks setting a first password.
ID tokens use site HS256 secret without nonce; userinfo does not check app status; grant record failure is swallowed.
User/account/OAuth provisioning can be half-committed; compensation failure lacks durable recovery state.
Legacy unique index migration drops old index before creating NOCASE unique index; failure only warns and leaves no unique constraint.
OAuth authorize login/MFA, draft name slot, auto-refresh condition, request race, route name, slow-network session handling, export range/recipient remain inconsistent.
Negative size bypasses upper bound and can return all rows.
Profile fields have no length/URL caps; large KV/public profile responses possible.
Report reason is unbounded and reports are not deduplicated/rate-limited; audit table can be inflated.
Authenticated test endpoint accepts arbitrary bot token/chat ID without rate limit.
Personal access tokens are issued and stored in plaintext but no route consumes them.
Visitor role with setting:query receives partially masked secret prefixes.
Direct Apple id_token login accepts no state/nonce and can replay a stolen token within TTL.
DB health check performs full table reads, swallows errors, and still reports healthy/connected.
KV rate limiting is non-atomic and fail-open.
Production defaults allow init secret in URL and fall back to jwt_secret.
Existing demo visitor accounts are not remediated by the new seeding guard.
URL safety check does not resolve DNS; BYO storage endpoint can be a rebinding vector.
Attachment response omits original filename.
Public profile exposes full email when publicProfile is enabled.
Account names are not unique after rename; username login can be ambiguous.
Self-service account deletion has no password/MFA step-up.
test:integration lists 21 of 37 spec files; script name overstates coverage.
